kicker: Compiling a layout, read and rebuilt

scenes.headline: How a page layout becomes one formula
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Slope! This is how a page layout can be written as a list of arithmetic.

scenes.text: Write every if as a step and every max as a ReLU, and a page layout becomes a list of sums and products.
scenes.mark: a list of sums and products
scenes.say: Turn every if into a step and every max into a ReLU, and the layout is just a list of sums and products.

scenes.title: How an if becomes arithmetic
scenes.say: Both branches always run, and a number from zero to one decides which counts.

parts.note: a step: one when the test holds, else zero
parts.say: The step is one when the test holds, and zero when it does not.

parts.note: the gap between the two branches
parts.say: It scales the gap between the two branches.
Start from the else branch and add the difference.

steps.say: A tracer runs the component once with the props as unknowns.
Each operation it meets is appended to a list of four kinds of node.
The same list can be read exactly, softened, differentiated, or bounded.
The result is a position and a size for every card.

scenes.title: Two ways to lay out cards

left.title: The usual way
items: Loops stop when rows run out
left.say: Ordinary code branches to pick a column count, and loops until the rows run out.

right.title: The formula way
right.say: The formula lays the grid out for every possible column count, then blends them with the one hot of the real count.

scenes.title: Nodes in the program, by cards
scenes.note: grows with cards times column counts
scenes.say: The cost is every branch. One card is one hundred forty four nodes, and sixty four cards is three thousand nine hundred two.

scenes.text: Removing branches means computing all of them, so the formula is exact and differentiable away from its jumps, and big.
scenes.say: Remove the branches and you must compute every one of them. That buys exactness, and a gradient between the jumps.
An if is a step, a max is a ReLU, and every branch gets computed.
